description: Tropical cyclone and storm track data: Kazakhstan is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by HDX. The International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) project is the most complete global collection of tropical cyclones available. It merges recent and historical tropical cyclone data from multiple agencies to create a unified, publicly available, best-track dataset that improves inter-agency comparisons. Fields available: SID: A unique storm identifier (SID) assigned by IBTrACS algorithm. Coverage: Kazakhstan. The portal files it under the publisher HDX. Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-08-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
